note: How close an animal comes to a player (Dave 23 Nov 2026, first game on the real server: animals were "jumping right through us"). body_m is the species' reach from its middle to its nose or tusks, in metres; player_m is the player's own half width. No animal is moved, or drawn, nearer a player than body_m + player_m: the server stops a charge there and pulls back any step that would take it closer (server_animals keep_off_players, server_big_game), and the client never draws a body inside the local player (animal_view keep_off). For an animal that defends itself body_m + player_m stays below its defend hit_m, so a charge that reaches you hits (test_animal_contact.gd). Species not listed use default_m. Read by the server and the client.
